meta.summary:
A group of project developers filed a complaint with FERC about ISO-NE’s first cluster study conducted under Order 2023 rules, arguing that structural issues with the study methodology led to exorbitant interconnection cost estimates. 
 The post  ISO-NE Developers Challenge Cluster Study After ‘Project-killing Costs’  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

meta.summary:
Data centers are sprouting everywhere, bringing massive demands for electricity. In response, Google recently partnered with Georgia Power to finance capacity uprates at a nuclear power through a new subscription program. 
 The post  Powering the Grid from Both Ends: Why Big Tech’s Nuclear Gamble Needs Energy Efficiency  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: DOE to Loan Vistra up to $4.2B for Nuclear Upgrades

meta.summary:
